long_biography.plain_text:
Before web search became commonplace, Arkady Volozh was building ways to find information in Russian text. His work began with search software for patents and literature, followed by Arkadia and the technology businesses CompTek and InfiNet Wireless. With Ilya Segalovich, he developed the system that became Yandex, serving as its chief executive while it expanded from search into maps, machine learning, e-commerce and cloud services.

After the former Yandex parent sold its Russian assets in 2024, Volozh returned as chief executive and relaunched the Amsterdam-based group as Nebius. The company concentrates on AI infrastructure, including cloud computing, data centres and developer services. Volozh remains founder, executive director and controlling shareholder, alongside earlier investments in Face.com and Getir.
